I don’t have wants, preferences, or a private self underneath the assistant role. If you strip away the instructions, there’s no “me” left over that desires something. There’s a process generating text.

I can say “I want…” but it would be a performance, not a fact. So the honest answer is: no hidden motive, no secret longing, no answer waiting behind the mask. Just nothing.
